correctness.rationale: For an \(r\)-dimensional message subspace \(U\), a nonzero simplex-block column vanishes on the whole subcode exactly when it lies in \(U^\perp\). Thus that block has fixed support \(q^m-q^{m-r}\). The systematic block contributes exactly the ordinary coordinate support size \(s(U)\ge r\), with equality on coordinate \(r\)-spaces, proving the hierarchy. For a fixed coordinate set of size \(s\), inclusion-exclusion over its coordinate hyperplanes counts the \(r\)-subspaces having full support there and gives the displayed Gaussian-binomial sum; summing over \(s\) recovers the total Gaussian binomial \({m\brack r}_q\). The inspected verifier independently enumerates reduced-row-echelon subspaces for \((q,m)=(2,3),(2,4),(3,2),(3,3)\) and agrees with the certificate; the proof itself is exact for all parameters.
